description: Crispy-skin salmon with a dressed salad (the repro case). Stresses a multi-word component name referenced abstractly ('the dressing' for 'Base B Vinaigrette') and skin-on / hyphenated names.
steps: Score the skin of the salmon fillets and pat completely dry.
Season the skin generously with flaky sea salt.
Heat the neutral oil in a stainless pan until shimmering.
Lay the salmon skin-side down and press gently; cook until the skin is crisp.
Meanwhile, tear the little gem lettuce and thinly slice the watermelon radish.
Slice the avocado and arrange it with the greens.
Dress the salad with the dressing and finish with a squeeze of lemon.
